Title: Inception
Description: A skilled thief enters people's dreams to steal secrets and is given a chance to erase his past by planting an idea in a target's mind.

Title: The Matrix
Description: A computer hacker discovers that reality is a simulated world controlled by intelligent machines and joins a rebellion to free humanity.

Title: Interstellar
Description: A team of astronauts travels through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity as Earth faces environmental collapse.

Title: The Dark Knight
Description: Batman faces the Joker, a criminal mastermind who spreads chaos through Gotham and challenges the city's ideas of justice.

Title: Fight Club
Description: An unhappy office worker forms an underground fight club with a charismatic stranger, leading to a dark exploration of identity and consumerism.

Title: The Shawshank Redemption
Description: A banker wrongly convicted of murder builds friendships and hope while serving a life sentence in prison.

Title: The Godfather
Description: The aging head of a powerful crime family transfers control to his reluctant son, drawing him into the world of organized crime.

Title: Pulp Fiction
Description: Interconnected stories follow hitmen, a boxer, and criminals through unexpected events in the Los Angeles underworld.

Title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
Description: A young hobbit and his companions embark on a dangerous journey to destroy a powerful ring and prevent darkness from conquering their world.

Title: The Silence of the Lambs
Description: A young FBI trainee seeks help from an imprisoned psychiatrist and serial killer to catch another murderer.

Title: Forrest Gump
Description: A kind-hearted man recounts his extraordinary life while unknowingly influencing major historical events and touching the lives of people around him.

Title: The Social Network
Description: A Harvard student creates a social networking platform, leading to rapid success, strained friendships, and legal disputes.

Title: The Prestige
Description: Two rival magicians in Victorian London compete to create the ultimate illusion, sacrificing relationships and ethics in their pursuit of greatness.

Title: The Truman Show
Description: A man begins to suspect that his seemingly ordinary life is actually a television show watched by millions.

Title: Se7en
Description: Two detectives investigate a series of murders inspired by the seven deadly sins while pursuing a methodical serial killer.

Title: The Green Mile
Description: A prison guard encounters a gentle death-row inmate with mysterious abilities that challenge his understanding of justice and compassion.

Title: Saving Private Ryan
Description: During World War II, soldiers are sent behind enemy lines to rescue a paratrooper whose brothers have been killed in combat.

Title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
Description: A legendary hotel concierge and his young lobby boy become involved in a stolen painting, a family fortune, and a murder mystery.
